mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT AB.PARENTID AS REORGID, AB.PARENTNAME AS REORGNAME, AB.ORGID, AB.ORGNAME, C.ORGID AS SECOND_ORGID, C.ORGNAME AS SECOND_ORGNAME FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT A.ORGID AS PARENTID , A.ORGNAME AS PARENTNAME, B.ORGID, B.ORGNAME FROM T_ECC_ORRELA A, T_ECC_ORRELA B WHERE A.ORGID = B.REORGID AND A.STAT='STAR' AND B.STAT='STAR' AND A.REORGID='0' )AB LEFT JOIN T_ECC_ORRELA C ON AB.ORGID=C.REORGID AND C.STAT='STAR'
AND AB.ORGID=#{orgId}
AND ( C.EMNAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{orgName}), '%') OR C.EMNAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{orgName}), '%') OR A.A2_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{orgName}), '%') OR A.A3_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{orgName}), '%') OR C.TITLENAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{orgName}), '%') )
ORDER BY REORGNAME DESC

SELECT DISTINCT A.ORGID AS REORGID , A.ORGNAME AS REORGNAME, '' ORGID, '' ORGNAME , '' AS SECOND_ORGID, '' AS SECOND_ORGNAME FROM T_ECC_ORRELA A WHERE A.STAT='STAR' AND A.REORGID='0' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT A.ORGID AS REORGID , A.ORGNAME AS REORGNAME, B.ORGID, B.ORGNAME , '' AS SECOND_ORGID, '' AS SECOND_ORGNAME FROM T_ECC_ORRELA A, T_ECC_ORRELA B WHERE A.ORGID = B.REORGID AND A.STAT='STAR' AND B.STAT='STAR' AND A.REORGID='0' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT AB.PARENTID AS REORGID, AB.PARENTNAME AS REORGNAME, AB.ORGID, AB.ORGNAME, C.ORGID AS SECOND_ORGID, C.ORGNAME AS SECOND_ORGNAME FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT A.ORGID AS PARENTID , A.ORGNAME AS PARENTNAME, B.ORGID, B.ORGNAME FROM T_ECC_ORRELA A, T_ECC_ORRELA B WHERE A.ORGID = B.REORGID AND A.STAT='STAR' AND B.STAT='STAR' AND A.REORGID='0' )AB JOIN T_ECC_ORRELA C ON AB.ORGID=C.REORGID AND C.STAT='STAR'

SELECT A.A1 AS REORGID, A.A1_NAME AS REORGNAME, A.A2 AS ORGID, A.A2_NAME AS ORGNAME, A.A3 AS SECOND_ORGID, A.A3_NAME AS SECOND_ORGNAME, C.TITLEID AS TITLEID, C.TITLENAME AS TITLENAME, C.EMPID , C.EMNAME, EMP.LOGIN AS EMPSNAME, EMP.STAT AS EMPSTAT, C.STAT AS ORMEMBERSTAT FROM (SELECT A.REORGID AS A1, A.REORGNAME A1_NAME, A.ORGID A2, A.ORGNAME AS A2_NAME, B.ORGID A3, B.ORGNAME A3_NAME FROM T_ECC_ORRELA A, T_ECC_ORRELA B WHERE A.ORGID = B.REORGID AND A.STAT='STAR' AND B.STAT='STAR') A, T_ECC_ORMEMBER C,T_ECC_EMPLOYEE EMP WHERE C.ORGID = A.A3 AND EMP.EMPID=C.EMPID AND EMP.EMPID = #{userId} AND C.STAT='STAR' AND EMP.STAT ='STAR' AND lower(A.A2) like lower('217CMWA%')

insert.selectKey: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_ECC_USERLOGIN_INFO T WHERE T.LOGINID = #{loginId}
insert.if: UPDATE T_ECC_USERLOGIN_INFO SET LOGINDATE = SYSDATE, LOGINERRORCOUNT = LOGINERRORCOUNT+1 WHERE LOGINID = #{loginId}
INSERT INTO T_ECC_USERLOGIN_INFO VALUES( TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') || LPAD(SEQ_T_ECC_USERLOGIN_INFO_ID.NEXTVAL, 6,'0'), #{loginId}, SYSDATE, '1' )
